description: Defines structures and functions related to creating deep links for sharing content via the OpenClaw application. Includes a SharedContentPayload struct and the ShareToAgentDeepLink enum with methods to construct URLs and message strings for sharing content.

classes.name: SharedContentPayload
classes.description: A data structure representing shared content with optional title, URL, and text fields.

classes.name: ShareToAgentDeepLink
classes.description: A static utility for building deep links and messages for sharing content with the OpenClaw agent.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Creates a custom URL scheme link incorporating the shared content payload and optional instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string from the payload and instruction, with length limitation.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a string and filters out empty values.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum character count.
